rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something modern or belonging to the present age.

example.english: The design of this building is very contemporary.
example.traditional: 呢座大廈嘅設計好現代。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 daai6 haa6 ge3 cit3 gai3 hou2 jin6 doi6

rows.note: Use this when two people, things, or events belong to the same historical period rather than simply being modern.

example.english: Shakespeare and Tang Xianzu were contemporary playwrights.
example.traditional: 莎士比亞同湯顯祖係同時代嘅劇作家。
example.jyutping: saa1 si6 bei2 aa3 tung4 tong1 hin2 zou2 hai6 tung4 si4 doi6 ge3 kek6 zok3 gaa1
